facts.fact: 伊莱擦掉眼泪说，想再看星星就得活下来。
facts.anchor: If I want to see the stars again, I’ll just have to survive.

facts.fact: 伊莱转身走向屋顶的门，维克多看着他离开，叹了口气。
facts.anchor: He turned back toward the rooftop door. Victor watched him go, and sighed.

facts.fact: 维克多把旋钮调高，黑色屋顶与空白的白色走廊交替换位。
facts.anchor: the dark roof trading space with blank white halls

facts.fact: 这段幻影里他和伊莱还没有互相杀死对方。
facts.anchor: But one where he and Eli hadn’t killed each other yet.

facts.fact: 两名 EON 特工都没朝他扑来，都陷在塞雷娜的梦里。
穿深灰病号服的 EO 一只手有深伤口在滴血，眼睛清醒，不在做梦。
facts.anchor: the blood dripping from a deep cut in one hand, wasn’t dreaming

facts.fact: 他抬手开枪时，一股力量箍住手臂把它钉在原地。
facts.anchor: a force vised suddenly around his arm, pinning it in place

facts.fact: 维克多抓住那个 EO 受伤手上的神经并调到最大。
facts.anchor: He took hold of the nerves inside the EO’s injured hand

facts.fact: 又转过两个弯，他到了加百列的办公室，感到门后有 EO 的能量。
facts.anchor: felt the EO’s energy beyond the door

facts.fact: 门开了，伊莱·埃弗走了进来。
